title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1077 River Road, Suite 1, in Washington Crossing, Pennsylvania, as the "Susan C. Barnhart Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 1077 River Road, Suite 1, in Washington Crossing, Pennsylvania, as the Susan C. Barnhart Post Office.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Pennsylvania post office after Susan C. Barnhart.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1077 River Road, Suite 1, in Washington Crossing, Pennsylvania, the Susan C. Barnhart Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
